<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Hryngar Sharpshooter](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3061)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Hryngar sharpshooters serve both as ranged support for caravans and as snipers posted on guard towers overlooking quarries and other areas where workers toil away the hours. Hryngar sharpshooters also specialize in nonlethal methods of ranged combat—tactics they are often called upon to use when tracking down derelict debtors or those attempting to flee from their contractual obligations.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 14

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 12

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 9
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 202

**Perception** +4; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Dwarven](/Languages.aspx?ID=3), [Sakvroth](/Languages.aspx?ID=118)

</column>

**AC** 15

+2 status to saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=644)
</row>

**HP** 18

</row>

**[Light Blindness](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=68)** 

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
light mace +5 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Shove](/Traits.aspx?ID=193)),
**Damage** 1d4+1 bludgeoning

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
crossbow +7 ([range increment 120 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [reload 1](/Traits.aspx?ID=254)),
**Damage** 1d8 piercing or bola bolt

**Occult Innate Spells** DC 12
- **Cantrips (1st)**
[Sigil](/Spells.aspx?ID=286)
- **2nd**
[Blood Vendetta](/Spells.aspx?ID=675), [Paranoia](/Spells.aspx?ID=214)

**Bola Bolt**   This shot deals no damage, but on a hit, the target must succeed at a DC 16 Reflex save or be knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) and become [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) until it is freed with a successful DC 15 check to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296). This check can be attempted either by the target or a creature adjacent to the target.

</column>
